parties: Ester Industries Limited; Ester Loop Infinite Technologies Private Limited (ELITe, 50:50 JV); Leading Global Sports Brand (unnamed)
headline: Ester Loop Infinite Technologies (ELITe JV) secures multi-year LOI with global sports brand for up to 15,000 MT/year
sum: Ester Industries' 50:50 JV with Loop Infinite Technologies (ELITe) has secured a multi-year letter of intent from a leading global sports brand for annual sourcing of up to 15,000 metric tonnes. The LOI represents significant expansion of the JV's circular / recycled materials capability for apparel and footwear supply chains.
implication: The JV structure (50:50 co-ownership) allows Ester to ring-fence IP and operational risk in a dedicated circular-economy platform while retaining strategic control; the multi-year LOI triggers supply-chain resilience and ESG credibility in global consumer goods procurement - a potential precedent for Indian mid-cap manufacturers anchoring sustainability-linked offtake agreements.
detail: ELITe (Ester Loop Infinite Technologies Private Limited) is a 50:50 joint venture between Ester Industries and Loop Infinite Technologies, focused on sustainable / circular materials for global brands. The LOI commits the unnamed global sports brand to off-take of up to 15,000 metric tonnes per year over multiple years - a material volume commitment that establishes recurring revenue and supply-chain credibility. The announcement does not disclose contract value, but the tonnage and multi-year tenure suggest a material revenue driver for the JV and validation of Ester's pivot into higher-margin, ESG-aligned polymer recycling and circular solutions.
